nodes.label: POST /v1/admin/users/sync
nodes.rationale: Email is portal-owned; module sync never changes portal email for users that already have spartaUserId.

nodes.label: GET /v1/master/branches and /v1/master/areas (updatedSince sync)
nodes.rationale: meta.syncedAt is captured before the query so changes during the query are not missed on the next incremental sync.

nodes.label: SpartaSsoUserPayload (contract v2)
nodes.rationale: v2 adds contractVersion, spartaUserId, employeeId, branchCode while keeping v1 fields; modules must accept v1 during transition.

nodes.label: SSO error codes (INVALID_SSO_TOKEN, SSO_TOKEN_CONSUMED, SSO_TOKEN_EXPIRED, SSO_MODULE_MISMATCH)
nodes.norm_label: sso error codes (invalid_sso_token, sso_token_consumed, sso_token_expired, sso_module_mismatch)

nodes.label: Energy role mapping (AUDITOR, ENGINEER, MANAGER, USER)
nodes.norm_label: energy role mapping (auditor, engineer, manager, user)

nodes.label: Maintenance role mapping (ADMIN, BMS, BMC, BNM, MANAGER, USER)
nodes.norm_label: maintenance role mapping (admin, bms, bmc, bnm, manager, user)

nodes.label: Admin user and access management API
nodes.norm_label: admin user and access management api

nodes.label: OTP password recovery and change (HMAC-hashed OTP)
nodes.norm_label: otp password recovery and change (hmac-hashed otp)
nodes.rationale: OTP never stored plain text: codeHash = HMAC_SHA256(OTP_PEPPER, email:purpose:otp), with expiry and attempt limits.

nodes.label: mapUserRecord filter excluding MAINTENANCE for BRANCH_ADMIN
nodes.norm_label: mapuserrecord filter excluding maintenance for branch_admin

nodes.label: API .env.development config (DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, OTP_PEPPER, Gmail, module callbacks)
nodes.norm_label: api .env.development config (database_url, session_secret, otp_pepper, gmail, module callbacks)

nodes.label: Module-owned authorization (portal only guarantees identity + module list)
nodes.norm_label: module-owned authorization (portal only guarantees identity + module list)

nodes.label: User matching order: spartaUserId, employeeId, email
nodes.norm_label: user matching order: spartauserid, employeeid, email
nodes.rationale: spartaUserId never changes; email can change via portal, so storing spartaUserId keeps accounts linked after email changes.

nodes.label: Replace local login with redirect to SPARTA Login Portal
nodes.norm_label: replace local login with redirect to sparta login portal
nodes.rationale: Do not delete local auth logic until SSO is verified in production; keep old login page for rollback.

nodes.label: Verify Energy Prisma migration history before adding spartaUserId
nodes.norm_label: verify energy prisma migration history before adding spartauserid
nodes.rationale: Energy uses Prisma and has had migration-history sensitivity; check migrate status and back up schema first.

nodes.label: Branch-name uppercase default password (BRANCH_DEFAULT)
nodes.rationale: Branch password is never stored, derived from branch name while passwordState=BRANCH_DEFAULT; mustChangePassword forces a new Argon2id-hashed password before module access.

nodes.label: Cookie Strategy (SameSite=None split domain vs Lax shared domain)
nodes.norm_label: cookie strategy (samesite=none split domain vs lax shared domain)

nodes.label: Libraries Avoided (Passport, JWT, extra ORM, queue)
nodes.norm_label: libraries avoided (passport, jwt, extra orm, queue)
nodes.rationale: Simple auth flow; custom session lighter than Passport; server sessions revocable unlike JWT.

nodes.label: Server-side session with HttpOnly cookie
nodes.rationale: Server-side sessions in PostgreSQL are easier to revoke than JWTs; token stored as sha256(raw+SESSION_SECRET); no localStorage auth.

nodes.label: Module-side spartaUserId column mapping strategy
nodes.rationale: Do not merge module databases into SSO DB; keep historical user rows because reports/approvals reference local ids; add nullable spartaUserId then unique index once mapped.

nodes.label: BRANCH_ADMIN is email-notification-only in Maintenance
nodes.rationale: Blocking before password check avoids forcing an unneeded password-change flow, gives an explicit error, and still lets mixed-role users into other modules.

nodes.label: Frontend stack: React 19 + Vite 8 + TS 6 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui
nodes.norm_label: frontend stack: react 19 + vite 8 + ts 6 + tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui

nodes.label: Liveliness Toolkit (ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION dials)
nodes.rationale: Removing slop leaves a void; liveliness must be added deliberately, not assumed.

nodes.label: Purpose Test (technique without purpose is rejected)
nodes.norm_label: purpose test (technique without purpose is rejected)
nodes.rationale: The filter rejects technique without purpose, not technique itself; every visual decision must state what it serves.

nodes.label: No manual spacing on shadcn components
nodes.norm_label: no manual spacing on shadcn components
nodes.rationale: shadcn components have calibrated built-in spacing; manual spacing breaks visual consistency, so use parent layout wrappers instead.

nodes.label: Custom components must be reusable
nodes.rationale: Avoid one-off components; accept props, no hardcoded values, store in src/components/.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui First rule
nodes.rationale: Always check shadcn registry (list/search) before writing custom markup; reuse rather than rebuild.
